scope: All 31 frozen land entries of russia-1812 1812, through full intervals, including Riga 24 July–18 December. Distinct encounters, reliefs, blockade, main battles and retreat crossings remain distinct.
policy: Main session only. At most three preassigned families including Bodart and one targeted follow-up per entry. No separate review, subagent or model job. Bibliographic catalogue checks preceded assignment; no new historical passage was read before this record.
